risks.title: Intensification of mobile and fixed competition in Italy
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly mentioned in highlights ("Competition... showed signs of cooling" but remains structural). Moderate language but context of "erosion of traditional services" and "price pressure" indicates persistence. Trend stable with slight improvement in 2014. High weight: core of domestic business model.

risks.title: Dependence on pro-investment and pro-competitive regulation
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly cited in the industrial plan: "adequate revenues flows... made possible by... stable, pro-investment and pro-competitive regulation". Strong language ("essential", "must"). Trend stable but increasing risk with massive investments (€10 Bn). Critical weight: economic viability of the model depends on favorable regulatory framework.

risks.title: Technological transition toward data and OTT services
risks.score_rationale: Major strategic risk: "shift toward 'smart connectivity' consumption model" and "customers' habits moving toward increasing use of 'data' services". Language of urgency ("must", "essential"). Trend up: acceleration of voice/SMS cannibalization by data. High weight: business model in transition.

risks.title: Cybersecurity risk and customer data protection
risks.score_rationale: Implicit in digital services strategy (cloud, data, digital identity, TIM wallet). Moderate language but context of managing massive data and critical services. Trend up: expansion of cloud and data services. Moderate-high weight: growing dependence on IT platforms and customer data.

risks.title: Dependence on massive network infrastructure investments
risks.score_rationale: Investment plan of €10 Bn in Italy (2015-2017) + €4 Bn in Brazil. Strong language: "ambitious goal", "essential". Trend up: increase vs 2014 (€4.984 Bn). Critical weight: model viability depends on ability to finance and generate returns on these investments.

risks.title: Economic volatility and slowdown in Italy and Latin America
risks.score_rationale: Difficult macroeconomic context explicitly cited: "difficult macroeconomic context", "recessionary pressures", "slowdown in Latin American economies". Moderate language but direct impact on revenues. Trend stable but persistent risk. Moderate-high weight: 80% of revenues in Italy.

risks.title: Organizational transformation risk and change management
risks.score_rationale: Major transformation explicitly acknowledged: "radical changes that are very difficult to achieve at companies of this size and complexity". Warning language ("test... stamina to the very limit"). Trend up: scale of change (TIM brand unification, cost restructuring). Moderate-high weight: success of the plan depends on execution capability.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk and economic volatility in Brazil
risks.score_rationale: Brazil represents the 4th largest telecom market globally, TIM Brasil is the 2nd operator (75M customers). Moderate language: "slowdown in Latin American economies". Trend stable but increasing risk with investments (€4 Bn). Moderate weight: ~20% of revenues, but exposure to macroeconomic and FX volatility.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence or related technologies in the 2014 document. The strategy focuses on network infrastructure development (fiber, 4G), fixed-mobile convergence, and cloud services.
evidence: The document does not mention AI, generative models, or APIs related to AI.
The digital transformation discussed relies on cloud, data, and networks, with no reference to AI.
The partnerships mentioned involve OTT players and ICT startups, but not AI players.
